rows.behavior: kmctl init writes CLAUDE.md with the kmctl block whenever it is missing, and adds the block to AGENTS.md when that exists.
rows.fails_when: in a repository with only AGENTS.md, after init CLAUDE.md is missing or lacks the block, or AGENTS.md lacks the block or loses any of its text

rows.behavior: A CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md symlink that is dangling or points outside the repository is left alone with a warning naming the link and its target.
rows.fails_when: init creates or changes the target of a dangling link or of a link outside the repository, or gives no warning naming the link

rows.behavior: The other init tests still pass.
